rationale: Builds on the current recurrent-tail baseline with one compact structural change and one export-budget change. The recurrence now refreshes its reverse-tail anchor as earlier recurrent blocks come online, which should reduce over-anchoring late in the tail without adding new shapes or training overhead. The int8 keep set is reallocated away from duplicated tail query preservation toward recurrent value/projection tensors, which is more directly aligned with the carried tail path that survives final int8+zlib roundtrip scoring.
title: Reverse-Tail Anchor Refresh With Value-Path FP16 Reallocation
